title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
scope_text: Design of plain and reinforced concrete structures using limit state method; durability, detailing, serviceability.
current_edition_detail: Fourth revision; Amendment No. 6 (2024) is the latest amendment
superseded_by_or_notes: 5th revision in draft (WCD March 2025, IIT workshop Jan 2026); not expected before late 2026/2027
verification_source: Verified live: SiteSetu construction guide (updated 25-Aug-2026) + archive.org BIS record

title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
scope_text: Design of steel structures by limit state method: tension/compression members, beams, connections, stability.
superseded_by_or_notes: No newer revision published as of 2026
verification_source: Verified live: BIS-hosted PDF + SiteSetu guide + infralens.in

title: Design Loads (Other than Earthquake) - Dead Loads
scope_text: Unit weights of building materials and stored materials for dead load calculation.

title: Design Loads - Imposed (Live) Loads
scope_text: Live loads for different building occupancy types (residential, office, storage).

title: Design Loads - Wind Loads
scope_text: Basic wind speed map, terrain categories, pressure coefficients, dynamic response factor method.

title: Design Loads - Special Loads and Load Combinations
scope_text: Temperature effects and load combination rules for limit state and working stress design.

title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - General Provisions and Buildings
scope_text: Seismic zone map (Zones II-V), design response spectrum, base shear calculation for buildings.
superseded_by_or_notes: A 2025 seventh revision (more conservative forces) was published then WITHDRAWN by BIS in early 2026 after MoHUA cost-escalation concerns; 2016 edition restored as current. Real obsolescence-flag case study.
verification_source: Verified live: SiteSetu guide (25-Aug-2026) + archive.org BIS record + LinkedIn amendment summary

title: Ductile Design and Detailing of RC Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces
scope_text: Special confining reinforcement, beam-column joint detailing, shear wall boundary elements for seismic zones III-V.
verification_source: Verified live: archive.org BIS record (Status: Active) + SiteSetu guide

title: Criteria for Structural Safety of Tall Concrete Buildings
scope_text: Structural systems, drift limits, performance-based design and wind-tunnel testing for buildings 50-250m tall.

scope_text: PSC using granulated blast furnace slag; preferred for marine and sulphate-exposure environments.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification

scope_text: Standard method for concrete mix design: target mean strength, water-cement ratio, aggregate proportioning.

title: Methods of Test for Strength of Concrete
scope_text: Compressive, flexural and split tensile strength test procedures for concrete.

scope_text: Master foundation code: settlement limits, bearing pressure, depth, construction precautions.

title: Determination of Bearing Capacity of Shallow Foundations

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Specification
